name: Vikram Solar Ltd
title: Vikram Solar Ltd - 544488 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR4,800 crores and 3.3 GW shipments, but per-watt EBITDA falling from ~INR6 toward INR1.75–2 on non-DCR volumes as cell costs rise and captive cell is delayed to FY28.

capex.peers_comment: Management said the industry will rationalise to 80-100 GW of integrated capacity; headline module capacity announcements by others were dismissed as addressed by backward integration.
capex.quote: The discussion around the headline module capacity announcements will be addressed by the imminent backward integration.

triggers.label: Per-watt EBITDA falls to INR1.75-2
triggers.quote: the non-DCR volume should deliver an EBITDA of per watt peak at INR1.75 to INR2 throughout the year on an average basis
triggers.highlight: EBITDA of per watt peak at INR1.75 to INR2

triggers.label: Captive cell delayed; 9 GW cell by Q4 FY27
triggers.quote: the first cell rolling out in December 2026, taking us to roughly 70% of backward integration
triggers.highlight: first cell rolling out in December 2026

triggers.label: Q4 cost up INR0.80 vs realisation up INR0.60 per watt
triggers.quote: the cost actually went up by INR0.80. So that INR0.20 Additional incremental cost has dented the per -unit EBITDA
triggers.highlight: cost actually went up by INR0.80

triggers.label: Order book 8.2 GW; distribution orders removed
triggers.quote: Our order book stands at 8.2 gigawatts as on 31st March 2026

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA INR1,500-1,600 crore on 7.5-8 GW
triggers.quote: we plan to deliver approx. 7.5 to 8 gigawatts in FY27 to deliver an EBITDA about 74% more than what we have delivered in FY26

guidance.quote: we plan to deliver approx. 7.5 to 8 gigawatts in FY27
which therefore works out to a range of 1,500 to 1,600 crores
